inputs.name: lead_id
inputs.about: The Salesforce ID of the lead to add to the campaign.

inputs.name: campaign_id
inputs.about: The Salesforce ID of the campaign to add the lead to.

inputs.name: custom_fields
inputs.about: Dictionary of custom field API names and their values for CampaignMember. Custom field names typically end with '__c'.

tools.name: Add product to opportunity
tools.description: Adds a product (line item) to an opportunity. The product must exist in a pricebook entry that's associated with the opportunity's pricebook.

inputs.name: discount
inputs.about: Discount percentage (0-100). Cannot be used with TotalPrice.

inputs.name: quantity
inputs.about: The quantity of the product to add.

inputs.name: unit_price
inputs.about: The sales price per unit. Provide either unit_price or total_price — Salesforce does NOT auto-fill the price from the pricebook entry on insert, and omitting both fails with FIELD_INTEGRITY_EXCEPTION.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Optional description for this line item.

inputs.name: total_price
inputs.about: The total price for this line item. Cannot be used with UnitPrice or Discount.

inputs.name: service_date
inputs.about: Service date for the product in YYYY-MM-DD format.

inputs.name: custom_fields
inputs.about: Dictionary of custom field API names and their values. Custom field names typically end with '__c'.

inputs.name: opportunity_id
inputs.about: The Salesforce ID of the opportunity to add a product to.

inputs.about: The ID of the PricebookEntry that contains the product and price information. This links to a specific product in a specific pricebook. Entry must be active and match the opportunity's pricebook and currency; mismatches cause REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING or INVALID_CROSS_REFERENCE_KEY errors. Use SALESFOR

tools.name: Close or abort a job
tools.description: Tool to close or abort a Salesforce Bulk API v2 ingest job. Use when you need to finalize job processing by closing (state: UploadComplete) or cancel a job by aborting (state: Aborted). This is required for every ingest job - closing queues data for processing, while aborting cancels the job and deletes uploaded data.

inputs.name: state
inputs.about: The state to update the job to. 'UploadComplete' closes the job and queues uploaded data for processing. 'Aborted' cancels the job and deletes any uploaded data. This field is required.

inputs.name: job_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Bulk API v2 ingest job to close or abort.

inputs.name: custom_fields
inputs.about: Dictionary of custom field API names and their values. Custom field names typically end with '__c' (e.g., 'Completion_Source__c').

inputs.name: completion_notes

tools.name: Execute Composite Graph (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use SALESFORCE_POST_COMPOSITE_GRAPH instead. Tool to execute multiple Salesforce REST API requests in a single call using composite graphs. Use when you need to perform a series of related operations that should either all succeed or all fail together. Composite graphs support up to 500 subrequests per graph (compared to 25 for regular composite requests) and allow referencing outputs from previous subrequests using @{referenceId.fieldName} syntax.

inputs.name: graphs
inputs.about: Array of graph objects to execute. Each graph is transactional. Multiple graphs can be submitted in one request.

tools.name: Create bulk ingest job
tools.description: Create a Bulk API 2.0 ingest job (POST /jobs/ingest). Returns a job in the 'Open' state with an id and contentUrl. This is the first step of a bulk load: create the job here, upload CSV data to it (upload_job_data), then close it (close_or_abort_a_job with state=UploadComplete) to queue processing. Without this action the rest of the ingest-job family has no obtainable job_id.

inputs.name: operation
inputs.about: The processing operation for the job. 'upsert' requires external_id_field_name. 'hardDelete' permanently deletes records (bypassing the Recycle Bin) and requires the 'Bulk API Hard Delete' user permission.

inputs.name: line_ending
inputs.about: Line ending used in the CSV data you will upload. Defaults to LF if omitted.

inputs.name: object_type
inputs.about: The API name of the Salesforce object the job operates on (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'MyObject__c'). Sent to the API as the 'object' field.

inputs.name: content_type
inputs.about: Format of the data to be uploaded. Bulk API 2.0 ingest only supports 'CSV'.

inputs.name: column_delimiter
inputs.about: Column delimiter used in the CSV data you will upload. Defaults to COMMA if omitted.

inputs.name: assignment_rule_id
inputs.about: The ID of a specific assignment rule to run for Case or Lead records. Optional.

inputs.name: external_id_field_name
inputs.about: The external ID field API name used to match records. REQUIRED when operation is 'upsert'; ignored otherwise.

tools.name: Create bulk query job

Without this action the Bulk query family has no obtainable job_id.

inputs.name: operation

inputs.name: line_ending

inputs.name: content_type
inputs.about: Format of the query results. Bulk API 2.0 query only supports 'CSV'.

inputs.name: column_delimiter
inputs.about: Column delimiter for the CSV results. Defaults to COMMA if omitted.

inputs.name: correlationId

inputs.name: workTypeGroupId

inputs.name: filterByResources

inputs.name: schedulingPolicyId

inputs.name: engagementChannelTypeIds

inputs.name: allowConcurrentScheduling
inputs.about: Allow concurrent appointments; Salesforce defaults to false.

inputs.name: resourceLimitApptDistribution
inputs.about: Maximum resources to return when appointment distribution is enabled.

tools.name: Get appointment slots
tools.description: Find available Salesforce Scheduler time slots without booking appointments.

inputs.name: endTime
inputs.about: Inclusive latest slot end, as an ISO-8601 timestamp.

inputs.name: workType
inputs.about: Work type ID or inline duration and availability settings; use instead of workTypeGroupId.

inputs.name: accountId
inputs.about: Associated account ID, used for account visiting hours.

inputs.name: startTime
inputs.about: Inclusive earliest slot start, as an ISO-8601 timestamp. Defaults to now. Only slots within 31 days of the start are returned.

inputs.name: territoryIds
inputs.about: Service territory IDs where the work is performed.

inputs.name: correlationId
inputs.about: Custom identifier passed to the ServiceResourceScheduleHandler Apex interface.

inputs.name: workTypeGroupId
inputs.about: Work type group ID; use instead of workType.

inputs.name: primaryResourceId
inputs.about: Primary service resource ID; required when multi-resource scheduling is enabled.

inputs.name: schedulingPolicyId
inputs.about: AppointmentSchedulingPolicy ID. If omitted, provider defaults apply; only account visiting hours enforcement is used for slots.

inputs.name: requiredResourceIds
inputs.about: Service resource IDs that must be available during each slot.

inputs.name: engagementChannelTypeIds
inputs.about: At most one engagement channel type ID. Requires engagement channel scheduling enabled and shifts in the scheduling policy; operating hours rules are unsupported.

inputs.name: allowConcurrentScheduling
inputs.about: Allow concurrent appointments in a slot. Provider default is false.

tools.name: Get apps
tools.description: Tool to get metadata for all apps a user has access to. Use when you need to list available Salesforce applications or check app navigation items. Metadata for the selected app includes tabs on the app's navigation bar, while other apps don't include tab details.

inputs.name: form_factor
inputs.about: Specifies the form factor of the hardware/device the browser is running on. Determines which navigation items and metadata are returned. 'Large' for desktop/laptop, 'Medium' for tablets, 'Small' for mobile phones.

tools.name: Get campaign
tools.description: Retrieves a Salesforce campaign by ID and returns the fields represented in the response model.

inputs.name: campaign_id
inputs.about: The Salesforce ID of the campaign to retrieve.

tools.name: Get Chatter resources
tools.description: Tool to access Chatter resources directory. Use when you need to discover available Chatter feeds, groups, users, email digest controls, emojis, extensions, or streams.

tools.name: Get child records
tools.description: Tool to get child records for a specified parent record and child relationship name. Use when you need to retrieve related records from a parent-child relationship in Salesforce, such as getting all Contacts for an Account or all Opportunities for an Account. Results are paginated with configurable page size.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of API names of the related list's column fields to query. Supports spanning relationships in the format ObjectApiName.ChildRelationshipName.FieldApiName (e.g., Opportunity.Account.BillingAddress). If not specified, default fields are returned.

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: The number of list records to return per page. The default value is 5 and the value can be 1-2000.

inputs.name: record_id
inputs.about: The unique 18-character Salesforce ID of the parent record. This is the record whose child records you want to retrieve.

inputs.name: page_token
inputs.about: Token for pagination, used to navigate to a specific page of results. Obtained from the response's nextPageToken or previousPageToken fields.

inputs.name: optional_fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of additional field API names in the related list to query. These are additional fields queried for the records returned that don't create visible columns. If the field is not available to the user, no error occurs.

inputs.name: relationship_name
inputs.about: The API name of the child relationship (typically the plural form of the child object name). Common examples include 'Contacts', 'Opportunities', 'Cases', 'Tasks'.

tools.name: Get Compact Layouts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve compact layout information for multiple Salesforce objects. Use when you need to display object data in compact form for Lightning Experience, mobile apps, or custom interfaces.

inputs.name: object_list
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of Salesforce object names to retrieve compact layouts for (e.g., 'Account', 'Account,Contact', 'Account,Contact,Lead').

tools.name: Get composite resources
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of available composite resources in Salesforce. Use when you need to discover which composite API endpoints are available for batch operations.

tools.name: Get multiple records by IDs
tools.description: Retrieves multiple records of the same object type by IDs with a request body. Use when you need to retrieve more records than URL length limits allow (up to 2000 records vs ~800 via GET).

inputs.name: ids
inputs.about: Array of record IDs to retrieve. Maximum 2000 IDs per request.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Array of field names to retrieve for each record. Specifies which fields to return in the response.

inputs.name: sobject_name
inputs.about: The sObject type name (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'Lead', 'Opportunity'). This specifies which type of records to retrieve.

tools.name: Get consent preferences
tools.description: Tool to check consent preferences for a SINGLE action (e.g. email, track, fax, phone, solicit, shouldForget) across one or more records (Contact, Lead, User, Person Account, or Individual). Returns a result per identifier; the 'proceed' object is keyed by the requested action, not a fixed set of actions. To query multiple actions at once, use the /consent/multiaction endpoint instead.

inputs.name: ids
inputs.about: A comma-separated list of identifiers (email addresses or record IDs) for which consent data is being requested. These can be IDs of Lead, Contact, User, Person Account, or Individual records.

inputs.name: action
inputs.about: The consent action to check. Common values include 'email', 'track', 'fax', or 'shouldForget'. This determines what type of consent preference is being queried.

tools.name: Get contact
tools.description: Retrieves a Salesforce contact by ID, optionally requesting selected fields. The response is limited to fields represented by the tool's response schema.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-delimited string of Contact field API names to retrieve. If omitted, all fields are returned.

inputs.name: contact_id
inputs.about: The Salesforce ID of the contact to retrieve. Must be a valid 18-character Salesforce ID; names or emails are not valid substitutes.

tools.name: Retrieve specific contact by id
tools.description: Retrieves a Salesforce Contact by its unique ID; the ID must correspond to an existing Contact record in Salesforce.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The unique Salesforce ID of the Contact record to retrieve.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-delimited string of Contact field API names to retrieve. If omitted, a default set of fields is returned.

tools.name: Get dashboard
tools.description: Gets detailed metadata for a specific dashboard including its components, layout, and filters.

inputs.name: dashboard_id
inputs.about: The Salesforce ID of the dashboard to retrieve.

tools.name: Get dashboard components
tools.description: Read details and status for selected dashboard components without refreshing or saving.

inputs.name: dashboard_id
inputs.about: Salesforce dashboard ID. Discover it by listing dashboards.

inputs.name: component_ids
inputs.about: One or more component IDs belonging to this dashboard, obtained from its describe metadata. These are component IDs, not source report IDs.

tools.name: Get dashboard filter options
tools.description: Validate dashboard filter options against report fields without saving changes.

inputs.name: options
inputs.about: Proposed dashboard filter options to check for compatibility.

inputs.name: filter_columns
inputs.about: Source report fields against which to check the filter values.

tools.name: Get dashboard status
tools.description: Read dashboard component refresh status without triggering a refresh.

inputs.name: filter1
inputs.about: Selected option ID for the dashboard's first filter, not its label.

inputs.name: filter2
inputs.about: Selected option ID for the dashboard's second filter, not its label.

inputs.name: filter3
inputs.about: Selected option ID for the dashboard's third filter, not its label.

inputs.name: dashboard_id
inputs.about: Salesforce dashboard ID whose component refresh status to retrieve.

inputs.name: running_user
inputs.about: Optional running user ID. Requires permission to change the dashboard's running user and a valid selected user.

tools.name: Get data categories
tools.description: List visible Knowledge data category groups or retrieve one category's children.

inputs.name: group
inputs.about: Category group API name. Required only for category mode.

inputs.name: category
inputs.about: Category API name. Required only for category mode.

inputs.name: operation
inputs.about: List visible groups, or retrieve one category and its children.

inputs.name: accept_language
inputs.about: One ISO-639 language abbreviation with optional ISO-3166 country subtag for translated labels, e.g. en-US. Omit for untranslated labels.

inputs.name: top_categories_only
inputs.about: Groups mode only: true returns top categories; false returns the entire visible tree. Omitted uses Salesforce's default of true.

tools.name: Get deleted records
tools.description: List record IDs and deletion times for one Salesforce object and time window.

inputs.name: end
inputs.about: End of the deletion window, as a timezone-aware ISO 8601 datetime. Converted to UTC; Salesforce ignores seconds.

inputs.name: start
inputs.about: Start of the deletion window, as a timezone-aware ISO 8601 datetime. Converted to UTC; Salesforce ignores seconds. Must precede end. Results are available for at most the previous 15 days.

inputs.name: sobject
inputs.about: API name of the Salesforce object whose deleted records to list.

tools.name: Get Embedded Service configuration
tools.description: Retrieve an Embedded Service deployment's configuration or response headers.

inputs.name: headers_only
inputs.about: Use HEAD to retrieve only response headers instead of configuration JSON.

inputs.name: embedded_service_config_developer_name
inputs.about: Developer name of an Embedded Service deployment owned by the connected account, not its record ID.

tools.name: Get enhanced note content
tools.description: Download the rich-text Content blob for a Salesforce Enhanced Note.

inputs.name: content_note_id
inputs.about: The 15- or 18-character Salesforce ContentNote ID.

tools.name: Get file content
tools.description: Returns the binary content of a Salesforce file, including references to external files. Use when you need to download or retrieve the actual file data from Salesforce.

inputs.name: file_id
inputs.about: The 18-character Salesforce ID of the ContentDocument or ContentVersion file to retrieve.

inputs.name: version_id
inputs.about: Specifies a particular version of the file to retrieve. If not specified, returns the latest version.

inputs.name: rendition_type
inputs.about: Specifies the type of file rendition to return. Available values: THUMB120BY90, THUMB240BY180, THUMB720BY480, SVGZ, ORIGINAL_<File_Extension>.

tools.name: Get file information
tools.description: Tool to retrieve comprehensive metadata and information about a specified file in Salesforce. Use when you need detailed file information including ownership, sharing settings, download URLs, and rendition status.

inputs.name: file_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the file - 18-character Salesforce ID (ContentDocument ID or ContentVersion ID). Example: 069xx000000001AAAQ

tools.name: Get file shares
tools.description: Returns information about the objects with which the specified file has been shared. Use when you need to understand who has access to a specific file in Salesforce.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number to retrieve (1-based). Use next_page_url from the response to paginate.

inputs.name: file_id
inputs.about: The 18-character Salesforce ID of the ContentDocument (file) for which to retrieve share information.

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: Number of file-share records to return per page.

tools.name: Get folder
tools.description: Get a report or dashboard folder's details, ancestors, and sharing URLs.

inputs.name: folder_id
inputs.about: ID of the report or dashboard folder. Requires View access.

tools.name: Get folder share
tools.description: Retrieve one explicit access entry for a report or dashboard folder.

inputs.name: share_id
inputs.about: Salesforce share ID, discoverable with Get folder shares.

inputs.name: folder_id
inputs.about: Salesforce ID of the report or dashboard folder containing the share.

tools.name: Get folder shares
tools.description: Lists the explicit access entries for a report or dashboard folder.

inputs.name: folder_id
inputs.about: The unique Salesforce ID of the report or dashboard folder.

tools.name: Get global actions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve actions displayed in the Salesforce Global Actions menu with metadata. Use when you need to discover available global actions, quick actions, or custom buttons in the UI.

inputs.name: apiNames
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of action API names to filter results (e.g., 'NewTask,NewEvent,LogACall').

inputs.name: formFactor
inputs.about: Device form factor to filter actions. Valid values: 'Large' (Desktop), 'Medium' (Tablet), 'Small' (Mobile).

inputs.name: actionTypes
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of action types to filter (e.g., 'StandardButton,QuickAction,CustomButton,ProductivityAction').

tools.name: Get ingest job info
tools.description: Retrieve status, processing counts, and metadata for one Bulk API 2.0 ingest job.

inputs.name: job_id
inputs.about: ID of the Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 ingest job to inspect.

tools.name: Get invalid Apex compilation results
tools.description: Read compilation results for invalid Apex classes and triggers (API 68.0+).

inputs.name: api_version
inputs.about: Optional Salesforce API version override, such as '68.0'. This resource requires API 68.0 or later and org support for the selected version. Omit to use the higher of the connection version and 68.0. This selects the URL version, not a provider request parameter.

tools.name: Get job failed record results
tools.description: Tool to retrieve failed records from a Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 ingest job. Use when you need to get records that failed during a bulk operation, including error messages and original data.

inputs.name: job_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the bulk ingest job.

inputs.name: locator
inputs.about: Pagination token from the Sforce-Locator response header of a previous request, used to retrieve the next set of results.

inputs.name: max_records
inputs.about: The maximum number of records to retrieve per page. If omitted, the API returns the maximum number of records it can send in a single page.

tools.name: Get job successful record results
tools.description: Tool to retrieve successfully processed records from a Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 ingest job. Use when you need to get records that were successfully created or updated during a bulk operation.

inputs.name: job_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the bulk ingest job.

inputs.name: locator
inputs.about: Pagination token from the Sforce-Locator response header of a previous request, used to retrieve the next set of results.

inputs.name: max_records
inputs.about: The maximum number of records to retrieve per page. If omitted, the API returns the maximum number of records it can send in a single page.

tools.name: Get job unprocessed record results
tools.description: Tool to retrieve unprocessed records from a Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 ingest job. Use when you need to get records that were not processed during a bulk operation, typically due to job abortion or interruption.

inputs.name: job_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the bulk ingest job.

inputs.name: locator
inputs.about: Pagination token from the Sforce-Locator response header of a previous request, used to retrieve the next set of results.

inputs.name: max_records
inputs.about: The maximum number of records to retrieve per page. If omitted, the API returns the maximum number of records it can send in a single page.

tools.name: Get last selected app
tools.description: Retrieves the app the current user last selected or the app the user sees by default. Use when you need to determine which application the user is currently working in or should be using.

inputs.name: formFactor
inputs.about: Specifies the form factor of the hardware the browser is running on. Required by the UI API; defaults to 'Large'. 'Large' for desktop, 'Medium' for tablet, 'Small' for mobile.

tools.name: Get lead
tools.description: Retrieves a specific lead by ID from Salesforce, returning all available fields.

inputs.name: lead_id
inputs.about: The Salesforce ID of the lead to retrieve. Must be a Salesforce record ID (18-char format like '00QWd000005V3RmMAK'); names, emails, or external codes are not accepted — resolve to a Salesforce ID first using a search or query tool.

tools.name: Get List View Header Actions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve header actions on list views. Use when you need to get available actions, buttons, and quick actions displayed on a specific list view header in Salesforce.

inputs.name: list_view_id
inputs.about: The 18-character ID or API name of the list view for which to retrieve header actions.

tools.name: Get batch of list view metadata
tools.description: Tool to retrieve metadata for multiple list views in a single batch request. Use when you need to get list view configuration, columns, filters, and sorting for multiple list views at once.

inputs.name: list_view_ids
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of list view IDs to retrieve metadata for. Use the 18-character Salesforce list view IDs.

tools.name: Get list view metadata
tools.description: Returns list view metadata by object and list view API name. Use when you need to retrieve complete metadata information for a specific list view, including display columns, filters, sort order, permissions, and user preferences.

inputs.name: sobject_api_name
inputs.about: The API name of a supported Salesforce object.

inputs.name: list_view_api_name
inputs.about: The API name of the list view.

tools.name: Get list view records by ID
tools.description: Returns record data for a list view by its ID. Use when you need to retrieve records from a specific Salesforce list view.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Additional fields queried for the records returned. These fields don't create visible columns. If the field is not available to the user, an error occurs.

inputs.name: sort_by
inputs.about: The API name of the field the list view is sorted by. If the name is preceded with '-', the sort order is descending.

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: The number of list records viewed at one time. Default value is 50. Value can be 1-2000.

inputs.name: page_token
inputs.about: A token that represents the page offset used for pagination through result sets.

inputs.name: list_view_id
inputs.about: The ID of the list view to retrieve records from.

inputs.name: optional_fields
inputs.about: Additional fields queried for the records returned. These fields don't create visible columns. If the field is not available to the user, no error occurs and the field isn't included in the records.

tools.name: Get list view records by API name
tools.description: Retrieves paginated record data for a specified list view using the object and list view API names. Use when you need to fetch records that match a specific list view's filters and sorting criteria. Returns the same data that powers Lightning Experience list views.

inputs.name: where
inputs.about: Filter applied to returned records in GraphQL syntax.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of additional fields to query for the records returned. If a field is not available to the user, an error occurs. Example: 'Industry,AnnualRevenue,Description'

inputs.name: sortBy
inputs.about: The API name of the field to sort by. Prefix with '-' for descending order. Examples: 'Name', '-CreatedDate'

inputs.name: pageSize
inputs.about: Number of list records to return per page. Default: 50. Valid range: 1-2000.

inputs.name: pageToken
inputs.about: Token representing the page offset for pagination. Obtained from nextPageToken in previous responses.

inputs.name: searchTerm
inputs.about: A search term to filter results. Wildcards are supported.

inputs.name: optionalFields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of additional fields queried for the records. If a field is not available to the user, no error occurs and the field is not included. Example: 'CustomField__c,Phone'

inputs.name: sobject_api_name
inputs.about: The API name of a supported Salesforce object (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'Opportunity', 'Lead', 'Case').

inputs.name: list_view_api_name
inputs.about: The API name of a list view (e.g., 'AllAccounts', 'MyAccounts') or the 18-character list view ID.

tools.name: Get list view results
tools.description: Retrieves the results of a list view for a specified sObject. Returns column definitions and record data with a 2,000 record limit per response.

inputs.name: sobject
inputs.about: The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'Opportunity').

inputs.name: list_view_id
inputs.about: The unique 18-character ID of the list view to retrieve results from.

tools.name: Get lookup field suggestions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve lookup field suggestions for editing lookup fields with search filtering. Use when searching for records to populate a lookup field, supporting typeahead, recent, and full-text search.

inputs.name: q
inputs.about: Search query string used to filter and find matching records. Use for typeahead search.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for pagination of results.

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: Number of records to return per page.

inputs.name: form_factor
inputs.about: Device form factor: 'Large' for desktop, 'Medium' for tablet, 'Small' for mobile.

inputs.name: search_type
inputs.about: Type of search to perform: 'Recent' for most recently used matches, 'Search' for any match in searchable fields, 'TypeAhead' for matching names.

inputs.name: field_api_name
inputs.about: API name of the lookup field on the source object (e.g., 'AccountId', 'OwnerId').

inputs.name: object_api_name
inputs.about: API name of the object containing the lookup field (e.g., 'Opportunity', 'Account', 'Contact').

inputs.name: dependent_field_bindings
inputs.about: Lookup filter bindings for dependent lookups, specified as JSON string with field-value pairs for filtering.

tools.name: Get lookup field suggestions with POST
tools.description: Tool to get lookup field suggestions with POST request. Use when editing lookup fields with dependent lookup filtering or when you need to pass source record context in the request body.

inputs.name: q
inputs.about: The search term being queried. Used with TypeAhead or Search to find matching records. Leave empty for Recent searches.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: The page number for paginated results. Use this to navigate through multiple pages of lookup results.

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: Number of items to return per page. Controls the size of each page in paginated responses.

inputs.name: search_type
inputs.about: The type of search to perform. Valid values: 'Recent' (most recently used), 'TypeAhead' (matching names as user types), 'Search' (full search across searchable fields).

inputs.name: source_record
inputs.about: The source record context, including the object API name and fields. Required for dependent lookup filtering.

inputs.name: field_api_name
inputs.about: The API name of the lookup field (e.g., 'ContactId', 'AccountId', 'OwnerId').

inputs.name: object_api_name
inputs.about: The API name of the source object containing the lookup field (e.g., 'Case', 'Opportunity', 'Account').

inputs.name: dependent_field_bindings
inputs.about: Bindings for dependent lookup fields to apply contextual filtering based on other field values.

tools.name: Get Metadata Deployment Status
tools.description: Poll a Metadata API deployment request and optionally return detailed results.

inputs.name: include_details
inputs.about: Whether to include component and Apex test details in the deployment result.

inputs.name: deployment_request_id
inputs.about: Metadata deployment request ID returned by Salesforce.

tools.name: Get MRU list view metadata
tools.description: Tool to retrieve MRU list view metadata for a Salesforce object. Use when you need to understand the structure and configuration of the most recently used list view for an object.

inputs.name: sobject_api_name
inputs.about: The API name of the Salesforce object to retrieve MRU list view metadata for.

tools.name: Get most recently used list view records
tools.description: Tool to retrieve record data for an object's most recently used (MRU) list view. Use when you need to get the records that a user has recently accessed for a specific Salesforce object type.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of additional fields to query for returned records. An error occurs if a field is unavailable to the user.

inputs.name: sort_by
inputs.about: API name of the field to sort by. Prefix with '-' for descending order (e.g., 'CreatedDate' for ascending, '-CreatedDate' for descending).

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: Number of list records to view at one time. Default is 50, minimum is 1, maximum is 2000.

inputs.name: page_token
inputs.about: Token representing the page offset for pagination to retrieve subsequent pages of results.

inputs.name: optional_fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of additional fields to query for returned records. No error occurs if a field is unavailable to the user.

inputs.name: sobject_api_name
inputs.about: The API name of the Salesforce object to retrieve MRU list view records for (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'Opportunity').

tools.name: Get named layout
tools.description: Retrieve an object's alternate named layout by its discovered layout name.

inputs.name: sobject
inputs.about: Object API name whose alternate named layout to retrieve.

inputs.name: layout_name
inputs.about: Named layout name from the object's sObject Describe namedLayoutInfos field, not a layout ID.

tools.name: Get note
tools.description: Retrieves a specific note by ID from Salesforce, returning all available fields. Notes with IsPrivate=true require the integration user to have sufficient permissions; inaccessible private notes will not be returned.

inputs.name: note_id
inputs.about: The Salesforce ID of the note to retrieve.

tools.name: Retrieve Note with conditions
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Retrieves a Salesforce Note object by its ID, optionally specifying which fields to return; the Note ID must exist.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the Note object to retrieve.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-delimited API names of fields for the Note object (e.g., 'Title,Body'). If omitted, all accessible fields are retrieved.

tools.name: Get list views for an object
tools.description: Returns a collection of list views associated with a Salesforce object. Use when you need to discover available list views for an object like Account, Contact, or Opportunity.

inputs.name: sobject_api_name
inputs.about: The API name of the Salesforce object to retrieve list views for (e.g., Account, Contact, Opportunity).

tools.name: Get object UI layout
tools.description: Retrieve object-level UI layout metadata without requiring a record ID.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.about: Intended record access mode for the layout.

inputs.name: form_factor
inputs.about: Target display size for the layout.

inputs.name: layout_type
inputs.about: Layout detail level to retrieve.

inputs.name: record_type_id
inputs.about: Record type ID. Omit to use the default record type.

inputs.name: object_api_name
inputs.about: Supported Salesforce object API name.

tools.name: Get opportunity
tools.description: Retrieves a Salesforce opportunity by its ID, optionally requesting a selected set of fields. Use it to inspect the opportunity's details without retrieving every available field.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-delimited string of Opportunity field API names to retrieve. If omitted, all fields are returned. Custom objects may use non-standard API names for common fields (e.g., primary contact); verify exact field API names and handle null values.

inputs.name: opportunity_id
inputs.about: The Salesforce ID of the opportunity to retrieve. Must be a valid 15 or 18 character alphanumeric Salesforce ID (e.g., '006Wd000005FG3CIAW'). When multiple similarly named opportunities exist in search results, confirm the correct record by `Id` or other key attributes before passing the ID here.

tools.name: Get organization limits
tools.description: Tool to retrieve organization limits with max and remaining allocations. Use when you need to check API usage, storage limits, or other resource consumption in Salesforce.

tools.name: Get photo actions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve available photo actions for Salesforce pages. Use when you need to get photo management actions for user or group pages. Currently, only group and user pages support photo actions.

inputs.name: record_ids
inputs.about: The record ID(s) for which to retrieve photo actions. Can be a single User ID or Group ID, or comma-separated list of IDs.

inputs.name: form_factor
inputs.about: Specifies the device form factor for which to return actions. Large for Desktop/laptop, Medium for Tablet, Small for Mobile phone screens. If not specified, returns actions for all form factors.

inputs.name: action_types
inputs.about: Filters the types of actions to return. Can be a single value or comma-separated list. Valid values: StandardButton, QuickAction, CustomButton, ProductivityAction.

tools.name: Get Values for All Picklist Fields
tools.description: Tool to get values for all picklist fields of a record type, including dependent picklists. Use when you need to retrieve available picklist options for a specific object and record type, especially for dependent picklist hierarchies.

inputs.name: record_type_id
inputs.about: The 18-character Record Type ID. Use '012000000000000AAA' for objects without record types (default record type).

inputs.name: sobject_api_name
inputs.about: The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'Opportunity', or custom object like 'Car__c').

tools.name: Get platform event schema
tools.description: Read a platform event schema by event API name or schema ID, without publishing events.

inputs.name: schema_id
inputs.about: Schema ID, such as the uuid in a COMPACT schema. Mutually exclusive with event_name.

inputs.name: event_name
inputs.about: Platform event API name. Supply exactly one of event_name or schema_id.

inputs.name: payload_format
inputs.about: Returned schema format. Salesforce defaults to EXPANDED in API 43.0 and later; COMPACT adheres to Apache Avro.

tools.name: Get Process Approvals
tools.description: List Salesforce approval processes grouped by object, or read their headers.

inputs.name: headers_only
inputs.about: Use HEAD instead of GET to retrieve headers without approval data.

tools.name: Get process rules
tools.description: Read active workflow rules or their headers, globally, by object, or by rule ID.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.about: Read all active workflow rules, an object's rules, or one rule.

inputs.name: headers_only
inputs.about: Use HEAD instead of GET at the selected scope, without retrieving JSON.

inputs.name: sobject_name
inputs.about: Object API name. Required for object and rule scopes; omit for all.

inputs.name: workflow_rule_id
inputs.about: Workflow rule ID. Required only for rule scope; discover via all or object.

tools.name: Get job info query
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about a Salesforce Bulk API v2 query job. Use when you need to check the status and details of a query job.

inputs.name: job_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Bulk API v2 query job.

tools.name: Get job query result
tools.description: Retrieves results for a completed Bulk API v2 query job in CSV format. Supports pagination for large datasets via maxRecords and locator parameters.

inputs.name: job_id
inputs.about: The unique 18-character identifier for the query job whose results you want to retrieve.

inputs.name: locator
inputs.about: A Base64-encoded string used for pagination to retrieve the next set of records. This value is obtained from the Sforce-Locator response header of the previous request. Use this to traverse through subsequent pages of results.

inputs.name: max_records
inputs.about: Defines the number of records to be downloaded per page. If omitted, the API returns the maximum number of records it can send in a single page. Used to control page size for pagination.

tools.name: Get query result pages
tools.description: List up to five parallel result download links for a completed Bulk API 2.0 query job. Use the same connection API version used to create the job (58.0 or later), otherwise Salesforce returns 409. This lists links, not the CSV result data. Continue with the locator from nextRecordsUrl until done is true.

inputs.name: job_id
inputs.about: ID of a completed Bulk API 2.0 query job (JobComplete state).

inputs.name: locator
inputs.about: For continuation only: copy the locator query value from the previous response's nextRecordsUrl. Omit for the first page; never invent a locator.

tools.name: Get quick actions
tools.description: List global Salesforce quick actions and their types.

tools.name: Get record count for objects
tools.description: Tool to retrieve total record counts for specified Salesforce objects. Use when you need to check storage usage or understand data volume for specific sObjects.

inputs.name: sobjects
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of Salesforce object API names to retrieve record counts for. Examples: 'Account' for a single object or 'Account,Opportunity,Contact' for multiple objects.

tools.name: Get record edit page actions
tools.description: Tool to get available actions on record edit pages. Use when you need to retrieve metadata about actions (standard actions, custom actions, quick actions, productivity actions) displayed on the record edit page for specific records.

inputs.name: record_ids
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of 18-character Salesforce record IDs for which to retrieve record edit actions. Multiple IDs can be provided to retrieve actions for multiple records in a single request.

inputs.name: form_factor
inputs.about: The device form factor for which to retrieve actions. Valid values: 'Large' (desktop), 'Medium' (tablet), 'Small' (mobile/phone). This affects which actions are returned based on device type.

inputs.name: action_types
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of action types to filter results. Common values include: 'Standard', 'Custom', 'QuickAction', 'ProductivityAction', 'DefaultButton'.

inputs.name: retrieval_mode
inputs.about: Specifies how actions should be retrieved to control the retrieval behavior for actions.

tools.name: Get related list actions
tools.description: Tool to get actions on related lists for record detail pages. Use when you need to retrieve metadata about all available actions (standard buttons, quick actions, custom buttons, and productivity actions) that can be performed on records within a specific related list context.

inputs.name: record_ids
inputs.about: The 18-character Salesforce ID of the parent record for which to retrieve related list actions.

inputs.name: form_factor
inputs.about: Device form factor to filter actions by device type. 'Large' for desktop, 'Medium' for tablet, 'Small' for mobile.

inputs.name: action_types
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of action types to filter results. Valid values: 'StandardButton', 'QuickAction', 'CustomButton', 'ProductivityAction'.

inputs.name: retrieval_mode
inputs.about: Controls data retrieval from cache or server. Specifies how actions should be retrieved.

inputs.name: related_list_ids
inputs.about: The API name of the related list (e.g., 'Contacts', 'Opportunities', 'Cases'). For custom objects, use the plural form with '__r' suffix (e.g., 'Custom_Objects__r').

tools.name: Get batch of related list user preferences
tools.description: Tool to get a batch of related list user preferences from Salesforce. Use when retrieving display preferences, column widths, or sort orders for multiple related lists simultaneously.

inputs.name: related_list_ids
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of related list IDs. Each ID follows the format 'objectApiName.relatedListId' (e.g., 'Account.Contacts,Account.Opportunities').

tools.name: Get related list records with request body
tools.description: Tool to retrieve related list records with request body parameters for filtering and pagination. Use when you need to get records from a related list associated with a parent record with complex query parameters. Returns up to 1,999 records per related list with pagination support.

inputs.name: where
inputs.about: Filter to apply to related list records, written in GraphQL syntax (e.g., '{Name: {like: "A%"}}'). Note: Semi-joins and anti-joins filters are currently not supported.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: The API names of the related list's column fields to query. Supports spanning relationships using dot notation (e.g., 'Opportunity.Account.Name').

inputs.name: sort_by
inputs.about: An array of field API names to sort the related list by. Important: Despite being an array, it accepts only ONE value per request.

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: The number of list records to return per page. Default: 50. Range: 1-1999.

inputs.name: page_token
inputs.about: Token for pagination to navigate to a specific page of results. Obtained from nextPageToken or previousPageToken in previous responses.

inputs.name: optional_fields
inputs.about: API names of additional fields in the related list that don't create visible columns. If a field is not available to the user, no error occurs - it's simply omitted from the response.

inputs.name: related_list_id
inputs.about: The API name of the related list or child relationship (e.g., 'Contacts', 'Opportunities', 'Cases'). This is typically the plural form of the object name.

inputs.name: parent_record_id
inputs.about: The 18-character Salesforce ID of the parent record for which to retrieve related lists (e.g., Account ID, Opportunity ID).

tools.name: Get relevant items
tools.description: Get the current user's relevant record IDs grouped by Salesforce object.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.about: Set MRU for the documented most-recently-used query mode.

inputs.name: sobjects
inputs.about: Optional case-sensitive object API names to restrict the results.

inputs.name: last_updated_id
inputs.about: Compare the full result set with a previously returned lastUpdatedId.

inputs.name: object_last_updated_ids
inputs.about: Per-object comparison codes from a previous response. Each case-sensitive object name must also be present in sobjects.

tools.name: Get report metadata
tools.description: Gets detailed metadata for a specific report including its structure, columns, filters, and groupings. Only fields included in the report layout are returned; use SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY when specific fields outside the report layout are required.

inputs.name: report_id
inputs.about: The Salesforce ID of the report to retrieve metadata for.

tools.name: Get report fields
tools.description: Read a report's available filter fields, optionally intersecting other reports.

inputs.name: report_id
inputs.about: Salesforce ID of the source report whose filter fields to retrieve.

inputs.name: intersect_with
inputs.about: Optional unique report IDs to intersect with the source report. Omit to retrieve all available fields; supply IDs to find common dashboard filter fields.

tools.name: Get report instance results
tools.description: Gets the results of a report instance created by running a report. Poll `attributes.status` until it equals 'Success' before parsing results. Response data is nested under `factMap` and `reportExtendedMetadata`; an empty `factMap` or zero rows is a valid successful result, not an error.

inputs.name: report_id
inputs.about: The Salesforce ID of the report.

inputs.name: instance_id
inputs.about: The report instance ID returned from running a report.

tools.name: Get rich text image
tools.description: Download an image embedded in a Salesforce record's rich text area field.

inputs.name: sobject
inputs.about: API name of the object containing the rich text area field.

inputs.name: record_id
inputs.about: ID of the record containing the image.

inputs.name: field_name
inputs.about: API name of the rich text area field containing the image.

inputs.name: content_reference_id
inputs.about: Image reference ID, obtained from the refid query parameter in the image's src URL in the record's rich text field.

tools.name: Get scheduling resources
tools.description: Discover available Salesforce Scheduler REST resources and their URIs.

tools.name: Get search result layouts
tools.description: Retrieves search result layout information for specified sObjects. Use when you need to understand which fields are displayed in search results for objects.

inputs.name: object_names
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of sObject API names for which to retrieve search layouts (e.g., 'Account,Contact'). Can include standard objects (Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity, Case) and custom objects (CustomObject__c).

tools.name: Get search scope
tools.description: Get the connected user's default global search scope and object order.

tools.name: Search suggested queries
tools.description: Returns suggested searches based on the user's query string matching searches other users have performed in Salesforce Knowledge.

inputs.name: q
inputs.about: The search query string for which to return suggested queries. This is the partial text input from the user.

inputs.name: channel
inputs.about: The channel context for the search suggestions. Valid values: 'Pkb' (Public Knowledge Base), 'Csp' (Customer Service Portal), 'Prm' (Partner Portal), 'App' (Internal Application).

inputs.name: sobject
inputs.about: The Salesforce object type to focus the suggestions on. Limits suggestions to queries relevant to specific object types.

inputs.name: language
inputs.about: The language for the search suggestions. Required parameter. Use standard locale codes (e.g., 'en_US', 'fr_FR').

tools.name: Get self-service user password status
tools.description: Read a legacy self-service user's password expiration status or headers.

inputs.name: headers_only
inputs.about: Use HEAD to retrieve response headers without password status.

inputs.name: self_service_user_id
inputs.about: ID of a legacy SelfServiceUser, not a User or Experience Cloud user.

tools.name: Get sObject basic information
tools.description: Get basic sObject metadata, related resource URLs, and recent records.

inputs.name: sobject
inputs.about: Object API name whose basic metadata and recent items to retrieve. Accepts standard, custom, namespaced, and Lightning metrics objects.

tools.name: Get sObject by external ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a Salesforce record by matching an external ID field value. Use when you need to find a record using a custom external identifier instead of the Salesforce ID. The field specified must be marked as an External ID in Salesforce.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of field names to return. If not specified, returns all fields.

inputs.name: sobject
inputs.about: The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., Account, Contact, Custom__c).

inputs.name: field_name
inputs.about: The API name of the external ID field. Must be marked as an External ID field in the object's field definition.

inputs.name: field_value
inputs.about: The value of the external ID field to match. Will be URL-encoded automatically.

tools.name: Get multiple sObject records
tools.description: Tool to retrieve multiple records of the same sObject type in a single API call. Use when you need to fetch up to 200 records by their IDs. Returns an array of sObjects with the specified fields.

inputs.name: ids
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of record IDs to retrieve. Maximum 200 IDs for GET requests. Example: '001xx000003DGb2AAG,001xx000003DGb3AAG'.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of field names to retrieve for each record. Specifies which fields to return in the response. Example: 'Name,BillingCity,Email'.

inputs.name: all_or_none
inputs.about: If true, the entire operation rolls back if any record fails. If false (default), partial success is allowed and errors are returned for individual failed records.

inputs.name: sobject_type
inputs.about: The sObject type name to retrieve records from (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'Lead', 'Opportunity').

tools.name: Get sObject compact layouts
tools.description: Retrieve compact layouts and record type assignments for a Salesforce object.

inputs.name: sobject
inputs.about: API name of the Salesforce object whose compact layouts to retrieve.

tools.name: Get sObject layout headers
tools.description: Retrieve only HTTP headers for an object's approval or compact layouts.

inputs.name: sobject
inputs.about: Salesforce object API name whose layout headers to retrieve.

inputs.name: layout_type
inputs.about: Retrieve approval layout headers or compact layout headers.

tools.name: Get sObject layouts
tools.description: Retrieve an object's page layouts and record-type mappings, or HTTP headers.

inputs.name: sobject
inputs.about: Object API name whose page layouts and record-type mappings to retrieve.

inputs.name: headers_only
inputs.about: Use HEAD instead of GET to retrieve HTTP headers without layout JSON.

tools.name: Get sObject list view information
tools.description: Tool to retrieve basic information about a specific list view for an sObject. Use when you need to get list view metadata including its ID, label, developer name, and URLs for accessing results and detailed descriptions.

inputs.name: list_view_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier (18-character ID) of the specific list view to retrieve.

inputs.name: sobject_name
inputs.about: The type of sObject to which the list view applies (e.g., Account, Contact, Opportunity).

tools.name: Get list views for sObject
tools.description: Tool to retrieve list views for a specified sObject. Use when you need to discover available filtered views of records for objects like Account, Contact, Lead, or Opportunity.

inputs.name: sobject_name
inputs.about: The API name of the sObject type (e.g., Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity, Case). Required to specify which object type's list views to retrieve.

tools.name: Get PlatformAction SObject metadata
tools.description: Retrieve basic metadata and recent items for the PlatformAction sObject.

tools.name: Get sObject Quick Action Default Values by ID
tools.description: Retrieve default values for a quick action in a specific record context. The response includes only predefined fields, so other returned default values may be omitted.

inputs.name: sobject
inputs.about: The API name of the sObject type (e.g., Account, Contact, Case, Opportunity).

inputs.name: context_id
inputs.about: The ID of the parent/context record that the action is related to. Used to calculate context-specific default values based on the parent record.

inputs.name: action_name
inputs.about: The API name of the quick action (e.g., LogACall, NewContact, _LightningRelatedContact).

tools.name: Get sObject Quick Action Default Values
tools.description: Retrieve default values for a specific quick action on an sObject. The response includes only predefined fields, so other returned default values may be omitted.

inputs.name: sobject
inputs.about: The API name of the sObject type (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'Task').

inputs.name: action_name
inputs.about: The API name of the quick action (e.g., '_LightningRelatedContact', 'LogACall', 'NewTask').

tools.name: Get sObject quick actions
tools.description: List an object's quick actions, including global actions, or retrieve headers only.

inputs.name: sobject
inputs.about: API name of the Salesforce object whose quick actions to list.

inputs.name: headers_only
inputs.about: Use HEAD to retrieve response headers without action metadata.

tools.name: Get sObject record by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single Salesforce record by ID from any sObject type. Use when you need to get detailed information about a specific record.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of field names to retrieve from the record. If omitted, all fields are returned. Example: Name,Id,CreatedDate,Industry

inputs.name: record_id
inputs.about: The unique Salesforce record ID (15 or 18 characters). The 3-character prefix indicates the object type (e.g., '001' for Account, '003' for Contact, '00Q' for Lead). Ensure the sobject_api_name matches the record ID prefix.

inputs.name: sobject_api_name
inputs.about: The API name of the Salesforce sObject type (e.g., Account, Contact, Opportunity, Custom__c). Object names are not case-sensitive. Ensure the sObject type matches the record ID prefix (e.g., Account IDs start with '001', Contact with '003', Lead with '00Q').

tools.name: Get records using sObject relationships
tools.description: Retrieves a collection of related records by traversing an sObject relationship, such as Contacts for an Account. The response includes pagination information when more records are available.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The 15 or 18-character Salesforce ID of the parent record.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve from the related records. If not specified, returns default fields.

inputs.name: sobject
inputs.about: The parent sObject type (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'Opportunity'). Must be a valid Salesforce object type.

inputs.name: relationship_field_name
inputs.about: The name of the relationship field to traverse (e.g., 'Contacts' for Account.Contacts, 'Opportunities' for Account.Opportunities).

tools.name: Get layouts for object with record type
tools.description: Tool to retrieve layout metadata for a specific record type on an object. Use when you need detailed information about page layouts, field positioning, sections, quick actions, related lists, and buttons for a particular record type.

inputs.name: sobject
inputs.about: The API name of the Salesforce object to retrieve layout information for.

inputs.name: record_type_id
inputs.about: The 18-character ID of the record type for which to retrieve layout information.

tools.name: Get approval layouts for object
tools.description: Retrieves approval layouts for a specified Salesforce object. Use when you need to understand which fields are displayed in approval pages or to dynamically build approval interfaces.

inputs.name: sobject_name
inputs.about: The API name of the Salesforce object to retrieve approval layouts for. Use standard object names (Account, Contact, Opportunity, Case) or custom object API names ending in __c.

tools.name: Get updated sObject records
tools.description: Retrieves IDs of sObject records updated within a specified timeframe, along with the latest date covered. Use it to track changes or synchronize records of a specified object type.

inputs.name: end
inputs.about: End of the timeframe for which to retrieve updated records. Must be in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2025-12-23T23:59:59Z). The date range between start and end cannot exceed 30 days.

inputs.name: start
inputs.about: Start of the timeframe for which to retrieve updated records. Must be in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2025-12-23T10:22:26Z). Cannot be more than 30 days ago from the current date.

inputs.name: sobject
inputs.about: The API name of the sObject type to query for updated records (e.g., Account, Contact, CustomObject__c).

tools.name: Get support knowledge
tools.description: Retrieves the root of the Support Knowledge REST API. Use when you need to access knowledge articles and data category information.

tools.name: Get directory of supported objects
tools.description: Tool to get a Salesforce org's active theme and directory of supported objects. Use when you need to discover available objects that are supported by the User Interface API, including their CRUD permissions, labels, and theme information.

inputs.name: q
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of object API names to filter the response. When provided, only returns metadata for the specified objects. If omitted, returns all available objects.

tools.name: Get support knowledge articles
tools.description: Retrieves visible Salesforce Knowledge articles, with filters including publication status and data categories. Access to published, draft, or archived articles depends on user permissions.

inputs.name: sort
inputs.about: Sort order for results (e.g., 'mostViewed').

inputs.name: topics
inputs.about: Filter articles by topics.

inputs.name: channel
inputs.about: Specifies the visibility channel through which articles are accessed. Valid values: 'App' (internal app), 'Pkb' (public knowledge base), 'Csp' (customer portal), 'Prm' (partner portal).

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: Number of articles to return per page for pagination.

inputs.name: categories
inputs.about: Filters articles by data category groups and categories. Format varies based on category structure.

inputs.name: page_number
inputs.about: Page number for paginated results.

inputs.name: publish_status
inputs.about: Filter by publication status. Values: 'Draft', 'Online' (published), 'Archived'. Note: Requires 'Manage Articles' permission for 'Online' status. In API version 47.0+ with Lightning Knowledge, all statuses are returned by default.

inputs.name: accept_language
inputs.about: Language for the knowledge articles. Must be specified in HTTP header format (e.g., 'en-US', 'en-US,en;q=0.9'). This field is required by the Salesforce API.

tools.name: Get Survey Translations
tools.description: Read translated Survey Flow field values individually or in a batch.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.about: Read one path-addressed field with single, or an array of field/language pairs with batch.

inputs.name: language
inputs.about: Translation language code; required only in single mode.

inputs.name: translations
inputs.about: Field/language pairs to retrieve; required only in batch mode.

inputs.name: developer_name
inputs.about: Survey Flow field developer name; required only in single mode.

tools.name: Get tabs
tools.description: List all tabs available to the current user, or inspect their HTTP headers.

inputs.name: headers_only
inputs.about: Use HEAD to return only HTTP headers instead of the tab list.

tools.name: Get theme
tools.description: Tool to get icons and colors for Salesforce UI themes. Use when you need to retrieve theme information for objects in the organization.

tools.name: Get Tooling completions
tools.description: Retrieve available Apex system symbol or Visualforce markup completions.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: Completion catalog to retrieve: apex for Apex system method symbols, or visualforce for Visualforce markup.

tools.name: Get Tooling FlexiPage
tools.description: Retrieve one FlexiPage metadata record by its Tooling API ID.

inputs.name: flexipage_id
inputs.about: The Salesforce Tooling API ID of the FlexiPage metadata record to retrieve.

tools.name: Get Tooling API record
tools.description: Retrieve one complete Tooling API metadata record by object name and ID.

inputs.name: record_id
inputs.about: The Salesforce ID of the Tooling API record to retrieve.

inputs.name: tooling_object
inputs.about: The Tooling API object name, such as Layout, Flow, or CustomField.

tools.name: Get lookup field actions
tools.description: Tool to get lookup field actions for a Salesforce object. Use when you need to retrieve available actions for lookup fields on a specific object type (e.g., Account, Contact).

inputs.name: sections
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of action sections to include in the response.

inputs.name: form_factor
inputs.about: The device form factor for which to retrieve actions. Valid values: 'Large' (desktop), 'Medium' (tablet), 'Small' (mobile).

inputs.name: action_types
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of action types to filter (e.g., 'standard,custom').

inputs.name: object_api_name
inputs.about: The API name of the object for which to retrieve lookup field actions.

tools.name: Get MRU List View Actions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve header actions available on the MRU (Most Recently Used) list view for a specified Salesforce object. Use when you need to get available actions, buttons, and quick actions for an object's list view.

inputs.name: form_factor
inputs.about: Specifies the device form factor for which to return actions (e.g., 'Large' for desktop, 'Small' for mobile).

inputs.name: action_types
inputs.about: Filters the types of actions to return. Can be used to limit the response to specific action categories.

inputs.name: object_api_name
inputs.about: The API name of the Salesforce object for which to retrieve MRU list view actions.

tools.name: Get related list actions
tools.description: Tool to get available actions on related lists for a record detail page. Use when you need to retrieve metadata about actions (standard actions, custom actions, quick actions, productivity actions) displayed on related lists for a specific parent record.

inputs.name: record_id
inputs.about: The 18-character ID of the parent record for which to retrieve related list actions.

inputs.name: form_factor
inputs.about: The form factor of the device running the browser. Valid values: 'Large' (desktop), 'Medium' (tablet), 'Small' (phone). This affects which actions are returned based on device type.

inputs.name: action_types
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of action types to filter results. Common values include: 'Standard', 'Custom', 'QuickAction', 'ProductivityAction', 'DefaultButton'.

inputs.name: retrieval_mode
inputs.about: Specifies how actions should be retrieved to control the retrieval behavior for actions.

inputs.name: related_list_ids
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of related list API names to filter the actions. For custom objects, use the plural form with '__r' suffix (e.g., 'Custom_Objects__r').

tools.name: Get Personalized Navigation Items
tools.description: Tool to get personalized navigation items for a specific Salesforce app. Use when you need to retrieve the navigation tabs that a user has access to within an application.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page offset starting position (default: 0). Example: page=2 with pageSize=10 returns items 21-30.

inputs.name: app_id
inputs.about: The ID of the Salesforce application for which to retrieve navigation items.

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: Maximum number of navigation items per page (default: 25).

inputs.name: form_factor
inputs.about: Specifies the device form factor for which to retrieve navigation items. Valid values: 'Large' (desktop, default), 'Medium' (tablet), or 'Small' (phone).

inputs.name: nav_item_names
inputs.about: List of TabDefinition name values to include. If omitted, returns all navigation items for the specified form factor.

tools.name: Get Account AllAccounts list view metadata
tools.description: Retrieves list view metadata for the Account AllAccounts view using Salesforce UI API. Use when you need to understand the structure, columns, filters, and sorting of the standard AllAccounts list view.

tools.name: Get List View Metadata
tools.description: Tool to get list view metadata from Salesforce UI API. Use when you need to retrieve configuration details for a list view including columns, filters, sorting, and permissions.

inputs.name: object_api_name
inputs.about: The API name of the Salesforce object. Examples: Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity, CustomObject__c.

inputs.name: list_view_api_name
inputs.about: The API name of the list view. Examples: AllAccounts, MyAccounts, __Recent. Special values like __Recent represent system-defined list views.

tools.name: Get Account SearchResult list view metadata
tools.description: Retrieves list view metadata for the Account __SearchResult view using Salesforce UI API. Use when you need to understand the structure, columns, filters, and sorting of search results for Accounts.

tools.name: Get List Views for Object
tools.description: Tool to get list views for a Salesforce object. Use when you need to retrieve available list views with options to filter by recent usage and search.

inputs.name: q
inputs.about: Search term to filter list view results. Supports wildcards.

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: Number of list view records to return per page. Valid range: 1-2000. Default: 20.

inputs.name: page_token
inputs.about: Page offset for pagination. Maximum offset: 2000. Default: 0.

inputs.name: object_api_name
inputs.about: The API name of the Salesforce object to retrieve list views for. Examples: Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity, CustomObject__c.

inputs.name: recent_lists_only
inputs.about: When true, returns only recently used list views. When false, returns all list views for the object.

tools.name: Get MRU List Info for Account
tools.description: Tool to get Most Recently Used (MRU) list view metadata for Account object. Use when you need to retrieve list view settings, display columns, and preferences. Note: This endpoint is deprecated and no longer updates.

tools.name: Get MRU List Records for Account
tools.description: Tool to get Most Recently Used (MRU) list view records for Account object. Use when you need to retrieve recently accessed Account records. Note: This endpoint is deprecated and no longer updates. It is not part of the Services under your Main Services Agreement with Salesforce and is for evaluation purposes only, not for production use.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Additional fields queried for the records returned that don't create visible columns. If the field is not available to the user, an error occurs.

inputs.name: sort_by
inputs.about: The API name of the field the list view is sorted by. If the name is preceded with '-', the sort order is descending. Example: 'CreatedDate' (ascending) or '-CreatedDate' (descending).

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: The number of list records viewed at one time. Default value is 50. Value can be 1-2000.

inputs.name: page_token
inputs.about: Token representing the page offset for pagination. Used to retrieve subsequent pages of results.

inputs.name: optional_fields
inputs.about: Additional fields queried for the records returned that don't create visible columns. If the field is not available to the user, no error occurs and the field isn't included in the records.

tools.name: Get record UI data and metadata

inputs.about: Timestamp of Note's last modification (Salesforce field `LastModifiedDate`). System-generated, read-only, and not updatable.

inputs.name: attributes__type
inputs.about: Type of the SObject, typically 'Note'. System-managed metadata, not part of an update request.

tools.name: Update task
tools.description: Updates an existing task in Salesforce with new information. Only provided fields will be updated.

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: Updated status. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

inputs.name: who_id
inputs.about: Updated Contact or Lead ID. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

inputs.name: subject
inputs.about: Updated subject/title of the task. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: The Salesforce ID of the task to update.

inputs.name: what_id
inputs.about: Updated related record ID. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

inputs.name: priority
inputs.about: Updated priority level. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Updated description or notes. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

inputs.name: activity_date
inputs.about: Updated due date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

inputs.name: custom_fields
inputs.about: Dictionary of custom field API names and their values. Custom field names typically end with '__c' (e.g., 'Priority_Level__c': 'High').

inputs.name: is_reminder_set
inputs.about: Whether to set/unset a reminder. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

inputs.name: reminder_date_time
inputs.about: Updated reminder date/time in ISO format. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

tools.name: Update Tooling Flow
tools.description: Delete and replace a draft Flow version with updated Tooling API Metadata. Salesforce assigns the replacement a different ID but does not return that ID.

inputs.name: flow_id
inputs.about: The Tooling API ID of the draft Flow version to replace.

inputs.name: flow_metadata
inputs.about: Complete updateable Metadata definition for the replacement Flow version. Start from the Metadata returned by SALESFORCE_GET_TOOLING_RECORD.

tools.name: Update Tooling API record
tools.description: Update a supported Salesforce Tooling API record by object name and ID.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Object-specific updateable fields. Supply complete Metadata where the Tooling object requires it.

inputs.name: record_id
inputs.about: The Salesforce ID of the Tooling API record to update.

inputs.name: object_name
inputs.about: The Tooling API object name, such as FlexiPage or FlowDefinition.

tools.name: Upload file to Salesforce Files
tools.description: Upload a file to Salesforce Files home via the Connect REST API. Use when you need to attach files to records or store them in a user's personal library. File size limit: 50 MB per request.

inputs.name: desc
inputs.about: Description of the file to help users understand its content.

inputs.name: file
inputs.about: File to upload to Salesforce Files home. Either 'file' or 'filename' + 'content_b64' must be provided.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: The title/name of the file in Salesforce. If not specified, the filename from the uploaded file will be used.

inputs.name: filename
inputs.about: the name of the file (e.g., 'document.pdf'). Must be used together with 'content_b64'.

inputs.name: content_b64
inputs.about: Base64-encoded file content. Must be used together with 'filename'.

inputs.name: mimetype_override
inputs.about: MIME type for the file when using filename/content_b64. Defaults to 'application/octet-stream' if not provided.

inputs.name: first_publish_location_id
inputs.about: The ID of the record to associate the file with (typically an 18-character Salesforce ID). If not specified, the file is uploaded to the user's personal library. Can be Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity, or other record IDs.

tools.name: Upload job data
tools.description: Tool to upload CSV data to a Salesforce Bulk API v2 ingest job. Use after creating a job and before closing it. Only ONE upload is allowed per job - multiple uploads will fail. After upload, close the job with state 'UploadComplete' to begin processing.

inputs.name: job_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Bulk API v2 ingest job to upload data to. This is the job ID returned from job creation.

inputs.name: csv_data
inputs.about: The CSV-formatted data to upload. First row must contain column headers matching Salesforce object field names. Subsequent rows contain the data records. Line endings must match the lineEnding parameter specified during job creation (LF or CRLF).

tools.name: Upsert sObject by External ID
tools.description: Upsert a Salesforce record by external ID, creating or updating it based on the matching value. An update-only option prevents creation when no record matches.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: JSON object containing the fields to create or update. Field names should be the Salesforce API names with their corresponding values.

inputs.name: sobject
inputs.about: The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., Account, Contact, CustomObject__c).

inputs.name: field_name
inputs.about: The API name of the external ID field. This field must be marked as 'External ID' in Salesforce.

inputs.name: field_value
inputs.about: The value of the external ID for the specific record to upsert.

inputs.name: update_only
inputs.about: Available in API v62.0+. When set to true, only updates existing records without creating new ones. Returns 404 if record doesn't exist.

tools.name: Upsert Survey Translations
tools.description: Add or update Survey Flow field translations individually or in a batch.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.about: Use single for one path-addressed field, or batch for an array of translations.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: Translated value, including an empty string if desired. Required in single mode; omit in batch mode.

inputs.name: language
inputs.about: Translation language code. Required in single mode; omit in batch mode.

inputs.name: translations
inputs.about: Typed translation records. Required in batch mode; omit in single mode.

inputs.name: developer_name
inputs.about: Survey Flow field developer name. Required in single mode; omit in batch mode.
